title: SMALL validates unrounded k against [1, n] before truncating k and preserves qualified overflow numbers
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, SMALL(array, k) validates the unrounded numeric k against 1 <= k <= n (returning #NUM! when k > n even if trunc(k) == n, such as k = 1 + 2^-52 on a 1-element array) before truncating k to the 1-based index, skips text/logicals/blanks inside arrays or ranges, and preserves qualified overflow numbers.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (row 207) and matched across 2,857/2,857 full-bank SMALL rows.

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0.20527.20088 Current Channel, Windows 64-bit (NT 10.0.26200), x86-64, AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, en-ZA
